[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
noble sampled French horn melody climbing in stepwise terraces
warm sampled string section carrying the harmony
plucked sampled bass stepping like footsteps on stone
sampled snare and timpani in a marching cadence, footsteps rather than a dance beat
soft wind swell cresting every four bars
mountain climbing route theme, determined, airy and adventurous, sunset thinning to cold blue
seamless transition back to the theme
